item.description:
community insecurity (#social) #bold #single
←→ when ppl ask for me to vote for them im so happy to say i will vote for them
big synthesis from the latest round of reflections is that i am so fucking norma
every time someone does something that shows they dont like me much i go scrolli
every time i feel that someone hates me i get very distressed (jackee, barak, ja
wow
Staring into the abyss as a core life skill benkuhn.net — https://www.benkuhn.ne always writing "but doesnt like me" 11.27 - i have a deep bias and very unnoticed bias against people who like me very very weird arya parents tin bora? tiffany? parth probably a proxy for getting better and better? you guys aren’t cool so i dont want to talk to you maybe learned from middle school also high school when ur too desperate you are undesirable i see them as below me i even like clara a lot because she isn’t that responsive when she responds or engages with me i feel much better than when my parents engage with me kinda like gambling or video games, variability causes more use (skinner’s box) i do enjoy being with my parents though and some of the other people that i shun due to this traitpaths to greatness: 1. tell them this, they become less clingy and more cool, i like them more possibly makes dad grow possibly hurts them 2. change to be less like this, they become less clingy because im less distant, i like them more i grow, go against an internal bias, understand the bias better helps in other cases as well defs bring up “i really dont like how dad is not doing anything though”dating rejections but also zaeem stuco being weird so at school the mean ppl judge me extended to work, friends, family, school aquaintances in which i have very strong success but ignore the successful sides a pattern is that i will recieve some insane compliments / people like me but i ignore that and try to win over the people that dont like me "the bias against people who like me" "losing interest once they showed interest." david being like ur probably the person i have been most aligned with my entire life other people praising me and saying insane things about me; i turn around and forget it immediately
dam a lot of people have a lot of confidence in me have list in raycast notes of people that love me even allat couldnt stop myself from bashing, feeling unconfident w.r.t. people, etc literally would take stuff i hear from people and say it to others in convos noticing this a lot more nowadays completely and utterly influenced by ppl around me about beliefs, esp about ai / neuro
#aboutme #identity #insecurity #personal

item.title: big synthesis from the latest round of reflections is that i
item.description:
big synthesis from the latest round of reflections is that i am so fucking normal and there is not a single thing insanely wrong about me. i have been scared this entire time for no reason. this is literally confidence xsinx roller coasters for the past year or so since i wrote confidence and now we are at a big peak that might just turn into constant or just x #bold not on yt not on attachment/social or dating not on sat not on comp not on credentials not on awkwardness/weirdness not on insecurity not on doing stuff all over the place not on fear (of other people not liking me) not on weird relationships not on weird words or not knowing things not on not being more cracked / more startup success rn not on not winning every single thing ive ever touched not on not being ready for college / not having the raw mats (or credentials) for it not on doing projects wrong before / not getting enough from it not on wasting a lot of time doing stuff that isnt important not on people snubbing me / people not liking me not on having weird relationships (julia s, analise, lora, sonnet) not on regressing from exceptionality from orbit not on being highly dependent on certain indicators from people that they like me (e.g. mark or albert or hux or school friends) and being highly swayed by their words not on listening to sad songs not on not having a clear purpose for life not on having wants towards money or attention not on grades not on not being cool not on not constantly working 24/7 or improving not on not being disciplined not on slow learning rate / dont know lots of things / suboptimal practices no need to be scared, just say the things and if people dont like it thats ok (cant get everyone to like you, ofc, ive heard this so many times)
#A #reflection #othersopinions
